info.title: FileGrid PPC API
info.description:
The real REST API of the NestJS backend, served by it at `GET /api/v1/docs-json`. It started as the
frontend's proposal (docs/api/openapi.frontend-proposal.yaml) and was corrected to what the backend answers;
backend/test/docs.e2e-spec.ts checks that every Nest route is here (and only those), that real answers and
live events match these schemas, and that every $ref resolves. Prose contract: docs/api.md.
Generate the frontend types from it: `API_SPEC=https://<host>/api/v1/docs-json npm run gen:api`.

Conventions (apply to every operation, not repeated per path):
- Base path `/api/v1` on the same origin as the UI (ADR-0002). This document: `GET /api/v1/docs-json` (no session).
- Auth: httpOnly cookie `__Host-fg_session` (`Secure; HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict; Path=/`) set by `POST /auth/login` (ADR-0006).
- CSRF: every non-GET/HEAD request carries `X-Requested-With: filegrid`; NestJS also checks `Origin`
  (or `Sec-Fetch-Site: same-origin`) and answers 403 `CSRF_REJECTED` otherwise. No CORS.
- Every response, including errors and 202s, carries `X-Trace-Id`; every error body uses `Error`.
- Timestamps are ISO 8601 UTC (`date-time`); IDs are opaque strings (never parse them).
- Lists return `{ data, meta }` with offset pagination (`page`, `pageSize`) and `meta.total` + `meta.hasMore`;
  small fixed lists return `{ data }` only.
- No storage URL, bucket, object key, FTP path, host or credential ever appears in a body, header or error;
  storage is the id `s3` | `ftp` | `db` (BA-00c).
- Personal data (connection documents) is masked by default; clear values only from `POST /files/{fileId}/reveal`.
- Role checks per the FE-01 matrix; foreign or invisible objects answer 404 (not 403).
- Error `code` values are UPPER_SNAKE and stable; `message` is Romanian and safe to show.

post.summary: Log in; sets the session cookie

get.summary: Whether the login form asks for a password (public, cacheable for 5 s)
get.description:
`passwordless` is true only when the backend runs with `FILEGRID_PASSWORDLESS_LOGIN=true` and demo mode
on (temporary, for the demo). The login page then shows only the role dropdown and sends `{username}`.

post.summary: Invalidate the session and clear the cookie

get.summary: Current user, active role, capabilities, demo mode and session expiry

post.summary: Extend the session ("Rămân conectat"); idle timeout restarts, absolute timeout unchanged

get.summary: All category policies with their current version

put.summary: Update a policy from the version the admin edited (optimistic concurrency); admin only

200.description: Saved; returns the new version. Uploads already started keep their policy snapshot.

409.description: `POLICY_VERSION_CONFLICT`: someone saved first; body carries the current policy.

get.summary: Version history, newest first

post.summary: Start an upload; authorised once here for the real user and the active role (BA-65)

200.description: Replay of the same `Idempotency-Key` (header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`); same body as 201.

get.summary: Received parts and status; the resume source of truth (BA-12); carries the result once finished

delete.summary: Cancel; aborts multipart / purges staged parts. Idempotent (BA-14)

put.summary: Send one part (raw bytes). Same part + same checksum is a no-op (BA-11)
put.description:
Exactly `chunkSize` bytes except the last part. `Content-Length` required (no chunked transfer).
The server hashes the bytes while streaming them to storage (no body parser, no buffering) and records
the part only if the hash equals `X-Part-SHA256`. Same part number with a different checksum before
`complete` replaces the part.

post.summary: Finish with the client SHA-256; server compares with its own (BA-13). Idempotent

200.description:
Verdict. A mismatch is still 200 with `verdict: mismatch`, `status: failed`, `fileId: null`
(the file is not made available) so the UI can show both hashes.

202.description:
Verification still running (large file read-back). `Retry-After` in seconds; poll
`GET /uploads/{uploadId}` until `result` is set. An SSE `upload.verified` event may arrive earlier.

head.summary: Connectivity probe for the upload engine; no auth, no-store

get.summary: Search/list files visible to the active role (BA-16)

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Text search on display name and non-personal metadata (request number allowed; never name/CNP)

get.summary: File detail incl. meter readings (BA-17, BA-33); personal data masked
Download through the API only (BA-18, N7); works as a plain link with the cookie
get.description:
Streams from storage. Headers: `Content-Disposition: attachment` (sanitised `filename` + `filename*`),
`Content-Type: application/octet-stream`, `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`,
`Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'none'; sandbox`, `ETag` derived from our SHA-256,
`Cache-Control: no-store` for connection documents. Never a redirect, never a storage URL.

409.description: `FILE_CORRUPT`: detected before streaming; body has `expectedSha256`, `actualSha256`, `storage` and `fallbackAvailable: false` (each file is stored once, so there is no copy to restore: the UI shows "notify the storage team").

post.summary: Server-side re-verification (FE-04 fallback for large files); audited as a custody event

get.summary: Chain-of-custody events, oldest first (BA-19)

post.summary: Reveal personal data for one connection document; auditor only, reason required, audited (BA-21)
post.description: `Cache-Control: no-store, private`. Calling again before `expiresAt` extends and is audited again.

get.summary: One operation's spans from the operation log (BA-20, D5)
Audit trail; auditor and admin only

parameters.name: actor
parameters.description: Username of the actor (userId is accepted as the same filter)

get.summary: Meter readings as a table; each row links to the normal file detail (BA-30, BA-33)

200.description: OK, newest first. `meta.total` may be an estimate (`meta.totalIsEstimate`).

post.summary: Ingest a batch of meter readings (idempotent on readingId)

get.summary: Received / unique / duplicates rejected / lost, readings per second (BA-32)

put.summary: Set normal / peak / custom rate; admin + demo mode only, audited (BA-31)

get.summary: Status of the 4 business guarantees; computed by the backend (thresholds live there)
Category × storage latency p50/p95/p99, throughput, error rate from the operation log (BA-43). Polled every 5 s
Per-category latency time series on one shared axis (BA-44). Polled every 5 s
Labelled normal/peak periods (seed days and each storm run)
S1 — measured performance per category × storage and a recommendation
S2 — the same metrics for two labelled periods (default last normal vs most recent peak)
S3 — faults by zone, consumption by hour and zone, meter anomalies

post.summary: Act as another role (admin, demo mode, allow-listed, TTL, audited with real_user/acting_as)

200.description: The new `me`. Clients reconnect the stream (it is filtered by the active role).

post.summary: Start a 10× storm for one category; records a labelled peak period; server caps factor and duration

200.description: Back to the normal rate: the simulator status

post.summary: Alter the stored bytes of one file (stored hash kept); audited (BA-62, OQ-11)

get.summary: Server-Sent Events for the active role
get.description:
`Content-Type: text/event-stream`, `Cache-Control: no-cache, no-transform`, `X-Accel-Buffering: no`.
First line `retry: 3000`. Every event has a monotonic `id:`; there is no replay (`Last-Event-ID` is ignored). A `ping` event every 20 s. Events are filtered by the session's active role and
the stream closes when the session ends. `data:` is one JSON object; the schema per `event:` name is in
`x-sse-events` (all schemas are also in `components.schemas`). Events are snapshots or hints; clients refetch over REST after (re)connecting.

503.description: `STREAM_BUSY`: STREAM_MAX_CLIENTS live streams are open on this replica (with `Retry-After`), or the replica is stopping

parameters.name: storage
parameters.description: db is refused (422): PostgreSQL also holds the metadata

post.summary: Stop or start one storage through the k8s API (demo mode, admin, audited)

meterApiKey.name: X-API-Key
meterApiKey.description: METER_API_KEY, for the simulator and smart meters

XTraceId.description: Trace ID of this request; shown in the UI and resolvable via `GET /traces/{traceId}`

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Client-generated UUID, persisted before the call

NotFound.description: `NOT_FOUND`, `UPLOAD_NOT_FOUND` (also for objects the caller may not see)

StorageUnavailable.description: `STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE`: the target storage is down; `storage` names it; other categories are unaffected

SimulatorUnavailable.description: The simulator is unreachable (SIMULATOR_UNAVAILABLE); retry later

Category.description: Team ids shared by the API, metrics and dashboards: meter_readings = citiri contoare, fault_records = înregistrări de avarie, connection_documents = documente de racordare, drone_videos = video inspecții dronă

UploadCategory.description: Categories uploaded from the UI (meter readings arrive from the simulator)

StorageLabel.description: A storage id only (db = PostgreSQL), never a URL, bucket, host or path.

message.example: Suma de control a părții nu coincide.

fallbackAvailable.description: FILE_CORRUPT only: whether a second copy exists to restore from (always false: one copy per file)

Interpretation.description: OQ-7. Either the backend sends Romanian `text` + `recommendation`, or null and the UI templates them from `facts`.

idleExpiresAt.description: Idle expiry; the UI warns 2 min before the earlier of the two

baseVersion.description: The version the admin edited; stale → 409

maxConcurrency.description: Server-side bulkhead for the category; unchanged when omitted

ConnectionMetadataInput.description: Sent once at upload start; never echoed back in clear (personal data).

fileSize.description: Bytes; a hint, the server counts real bytes

expiresAt.description: Refreshed by each part (suggested 24 h inactivity)

traceId.description: The trace of this part (the same as X-Trace-Id): GET /traces/{traceId}

name.description: The step: api (the whole request, always first), policy, encryption, storage.put, storage.get, hash.verify, audit, confirm. Never a path, key or host

attributes.description: Allow-listed, non-personal attributes: method, path (no query), uploadId, partNumber, category, storage, encrypted, sizeBytes, algorithm, keyId, action, outcome (see docs/api.md, "Trace spans")

details.description: Non-personal summary, e.g. chunkSize 8 MiB → 16 MiB

fileId.description: Opens the normal file detail and download

lost.description: sent - acked - queued as the simulator reports it; null while the simulator is unreachable. Must stay 0

durationS.description: Peak mode only: back to normal after this many seconds

GuaranteeMetric.description: Keys: received, unique, duplicatesRejected, lost (meter); uploadToAvailableP95Ms (fault); encryptedPct, unmaskEventsToday, lastAuditCheckAt (connection); transfersCompleted, transfersResumed, transfersFailed, successRate (drone)

value.description: Numeric values as decimal strings; timestamps ISO; null while there is no data in the window

causeFacts.description: Values the UI uses to build the Romanian sentence

sparkline.description: Optional p95 per step for the cell sparkline

end.description: null while a storm is running

county.description: OQ-6; null when granularity is the 3 regions

simulator.description: null while the simulator is unreachable

storm.description: The running meter storm, null when none

readingId.description: Idempotency key: a reading sent twice is stored once

duplicates.description: Already stored before (retries); acknowledged, never stored twice

up.description: null before the first health probe

ActorRef.description: Who did something, known by username; role is null when it is not known (the file uploader and custody events, a removed user, a system actor)
